DLC2302:3:t_3:38.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's wrong, $$正太郎$$? Why'd you yell all of a sudden...?」

DLC2302:3:t_3:39.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We still haven't finished looking for the kitten $$ローレライ$$ asked us to find!」

DLC2302:3:t_3:40.en:
$$甲児$$
「Oh... You don't need to worry about that.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:45.en:
$$お菊$$
「It's still a baby. Once it got hungry, it came home.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:46.en:
$$シロー$$
「$$お菊$$'s special kitty rice wins the day.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:47.en:
$$マッキー$$
「Hehe... Its tummy's so full, it looks ready to fall asleep.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:49.en:
$$しげる$$
「Let me pet it too, Sis!」

DLC2302:3:t_3:50.en:
$$お菊$$
「Now, now, you two. Don't fuss over the kitty too much.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:51.en:
$$加代$$
「That's right. If someone does everything for it, it'll never grow into a proper cat.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:52.en:
$$マッキー$$
「It's the same with people, isn't it?」

DLC2302:3:t_3:53.en:
$$お菊$$
「Exactly. But the young men of $c are growing up splendidly.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:54.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Quite so. By the time we can drop the 'young' from 'young president,' I'm sure our company will be secure as well.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:55.en:
$$加代$$
（Did you hear that, dear? $$ワッ太$$ is working hard too.）

DLC2302:3:t_3:56.en:
$$加代$$
（I'll have to live a long life so I can see him truly stand on his own two feet...）

DLC2302:3:t_3:60.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...And so, with help from $$甲児$$ and the others, $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$'s adventure ended safely.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:61.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ continue growing like this, how far will they go?」

DLC2302:3:t_3:62.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Surely, once $$ワッ太$$ has grown up, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ will finally pay those long-awaited bonuses.」

DLC2302:4:t_000:0.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Damn it! Then we'll burn $$熱海$$ to the ground and escape in the confusion!」

DLC2302:4:t_000:1.en:
$$安$$
「You really are thugs to the bitter end.」

DLC2302:4:t_000:2.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「The $$ロボットマフィア$$ used to throw their weight around in the underworld. How far they've fallen.」

DLC2302:4:t_000:3.en:
$$お菊$$
「This is a good opportunity. Let's finish them off here in $$熱海$$.」

DLC2302:4:t_001:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ロボットマフィア$$! We won't let you have your way!」

DLC2302:4:t_001:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Everyone worked hard to rebuild $$熱海$$ after those $$ミケーネ$$ bastards wrecked it! We'll protect it, no matter what!」

DLC2302:4:t_001:2.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Those bastards...! They just keep getting in our way!」

DLC2302:4:t_001:3.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Then it's time to play our trump card!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:1.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「What's the point of bringing out something like that now?」

DLC2302:4:t_002:2.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「Yeah, yeah! Let's beat it to a pulp!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「Wait! The way that $$タロス像$$ moves...!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:4.en:
$$厚井$$
「This is bad! The thing controlling it is...!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:7.en:
$$柿小路$$
「One of those $$ミケーネ$$ combat brains!?」

DLC2302:4:t_002:8.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「It was shot down during the $$時獄戦役$$, and we repaired it ourselves!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:9.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「We don't have many yet, but this should be more than enough to finish you off!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:12.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$正太郎$$, $$ワッ太$$! When a crook gets that full of himself, you tell him straight!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:14.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, you $$ブランチ$$ members! That's enough of your big talk!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:15.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We will never tolerate evil! Even if you have $$ケドラ$$, we won't lose to you!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:16.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Grrr! You mouthy little brats!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ aren't little kids anymore! They're warriors who protect the Earth!」

DLC2302:4:t_002:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's do this! We show no mercy to crooks who take advantage of the Earth's crisis!」

DLC2302:4:t_003:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But the members who escaped from their robots got away...」

DLC2302:4:t_003:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「I bet they're wishing they'd been arrested right about now.」

DLC2302:4:t_003:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Come on, let's go home. Join me for my first Japanese bath in ages.」

DLC2302:4:t_004:0.en:
$$さやか$$
「We've shot down all the $$タロス像$$ units.」

DLC2302:4:t_004:1.en:
$$ボス$$
「Now we won't have to fight those $$ケドラ$$ anymore.」

DLC2302:4:t_100:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Too bad, crooks! Even when we're away, $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ are here to protect Japan!」

DLC2302:4:t_100:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「But $$熱海$$ is my hometown! So I'll lend a hand just this once!」

DLC2302:4:t_101:0.en:
$$さやか$$
「The whole world is struggling to fight $$サイデリアル$$, and you're still pulling this sort of thing!」

DLC2302:4:t_101:1.en:
$$さやか$$
「I won't forgive you! I won't let you lay a finger on the peace we have here in Japan!」

DLC2302:4:t_102:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「I drop by $$くろがね屋$$ and end up fighting crooks... I can't tell if that's good luck or bad...」

DLC2302:4:t_102:1.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「What should we do, $$ボス$$? We've been working too hard lately, and we're worn out...」

DLC2302:4:t_102:2.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「$$正太郎$$ and $$ワッ太$$ are fired up. Why don't we leave it to them?」

DLC2302:4:t_102:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Good idea. Today, we'll just watch...」

DLC2302:4:t_102:9.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「Th-the $$くろがね五人衆$$ are looking at us!!」

DLC2302:4:t_102:10.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「This is bad, $$ボス$$! If we keep this up...!」

DLC2302:4:t_102:11.en:
$$ボス$$
「I-I know! Fighting $$ケドラ$$ is ten times better than getting punished by them!」

DLC2302:4:t_103:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I brought $$トライダー$$ just in case, but I never thought this would happen!」

DLC2302:4:t_103:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here I come, crooks! I'll pay you back in full for scaring $$しげる$$, $$サチ子$$ and Mom!」

DLC2302:4:t_104:0.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Let's go, everyone! From here on, this is official company business, not volunteer work!」

DLC2302:4:t_104:1.en:
$$厚井$$
「Understood! We've been entrusted with Japan's defense, and we'll do the job properly!」

DLC2302:4:t_104:2.en:
$$木下$$
「Let's go all out here! All out!」

DLC2302:4:t_104:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Yes! We'll protect $$熱海$$, no matter what!」

DLC2302:4:t_104:4.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ is here! Prepare yourselves, villains!」

review.context: The kitten returns for food while the adults celebrate the boys' growth. Combat events show Branch using repaired Kedora to cover their escape, with Kouji encouraging the boys and Boss intimidated into helping.
decisions: Kayo's inward address is to Watta's late father, so 'dear' preserves the intimate parental context.
The bonus-pay joke concerns company staff finally receiving bonuses.
Talos Statue is retained as the glossary unit name, with units added where English plural grammar requires it.
Deliberate unfinished conditionals and reaction fragments remain unfinished.
